name: config-merge-field-integrity
title: Catch field-level loss when a structured-config merge keeps both sides keys
description: A merge resolution of lattice.config.json kept the story side as base for entries present on both sides, silently dropping mains B-7dff resource declarations from 92 commands - 97 of 111 declared on main became 5 of 117. No command key was lost, so key-level review passed; nothing failed, because an undeclared command safely defaults to serial; and validate-resource-claims.test.mjs still passed because its only real-config assertion is declared.length > 0. Found as B-9ff1:F-079 and deferred here rather than patched from the story that found it, since the test belongs to B-7dff.
source: B-9ff1:F-079 (quality lane found and quantified it; test-coverage lane judged the coverage gap real and recommended filing rather than patching in place)
